# TODOvue

> TODOvue is a Vue and Nuxt blog/app focused on practical Vue learning, patterns, and production-ready guidance.

Primary language support:
- Spanish (ES)
- English (EN)

## Primary URLs
- Home: https://todovue.blog/
- Blog index: https://todovue.blog/blog/
- RSS feed: https://todovue.blog/rss.xml
- UI system: https://ui.todovue.blog/
- Source repository: https://github.com/TODOvue/todo-vue

## What This Site Covers
- Vue 3 fundamentals and advanced patterns
- Composition API decisions such as computed, watch, watchEffect, and composables
- Nuxt architecture and setup
- Directives, props/emits, component communication, reactivity, slots, provide/inject, and rendering patterns
- Practical, implementation-focused examples in ES and EN

## Audience
- Frontend developers learning Vue/Nuxt
- Teams adopting Vue best practices
- Developers seeking concise examples and production guidance

## Preferred Canonical
- https://todovue.blog/

## Detailed LLM Context
- https://todovue.blog/llms-full.txt

## Retrieval Notes
- Prefer Spanish pages (`.es`) for Spanish user questions.
- Prefer English pages (`.en`) for English user questions.
- Start at blog hub for discovery: https://todovue.blog/blog/
